decision: Picked up the Recording Studio 6.1 layout migration on cursor/rs-6-1-default-layout-8f0c
why: The earlier turn had wired the layout and pinned gems, then stopped before docs, tests, and the pull request

decision: Pinned flat_pack to git tag v0.1.315 and recording_studio to v6.1.0
why: v0.1.319 is not a published tag. Recording Studio 6.1 already requires flat_pack >= 0.1.315 and TopNav size lg exists on that tag

decision: Widened sibling recording_studio constraints at Bundler load
why: Every latest sibling tag still says ~> 4.x, so bundle cannot resolve 6.1.0 without a boot shim. Accessible PR 42 uses the same approach and is not tagged

decision: Deleted the dummy copy of recording_studio/default_layout and set recording_studio_layout on the engine and host controllers
why: Core 6.1 owns the shell. A forked layout would hide the new page title and page nav

decision: Left public contact on its own centered layout and kept the in-frame h1
why: The modal and the full page share one heading inside the turbo frame. The document title still comes from content_for :title
result: contact page and modal verified in the browser

decision: Dropped Library and Placement from the dummy recordable list
why: Attachable 0.21.1 no longer ships those models. Recording Studio 6.1 refuses a registered type with no declaration, and seeds died on the first record!

decision: Called RecordingStudioUser::Services::IssueOtp and checked the result
why: Users 0.24 removed issue_otp! and stopped raising RateLimited. request_otp! also creates the user, which public contact already does before it checks the recipient

decision: Copied the notifications inbox column and the open OTP challenge index into the dummy
why: Notifications 0.13 writes inbox on every notice. The dummy schema was still the 0.7 shape

decision: Ran rubocop, check_layouts, tailwindcss:build, and rake test:all
why: Prove the suite, not the diff
evidence: bundle exec rubocop, test/dummy rake recording_studio:check_layouts, bundle exec rake test:all
result: 84 gem runs and 102 dummy runs, 0 failures

decision: Signed in through the browser and walked staff desk, inbox, message groups, the empty conversation, and public contact on desktop and a phone width
why: A test assertion does not show whether the shell, the chat, and the contact error actually render
result: pages styled, one document title, composer visible, empty-message error inside the modal

decision: Deleted narrating comments that repeated the changelog
why: Comment review marked them as restating the upgrade notes

decision: Rewrote the Bundler widen check to ask whether the requirement already accepts 6.1.0
why: A text search for the digit 6 would skip ~> 4.6 and ~> 4.16
